comments.body:
Obtained at random from ファロス島 Legacy area's 10 light pillars; can only be visited from 12:00/Top relic Island of Pharos's Past from the Alexandria the Light of Wisdom Legacy Theme.

R16 Search is required to have a chance to obtain it. Can be transmuted into Improved Pharaoh's Robe ; see its page for more details.
